## Design

### 2026-10-07 – I worked on the schematic for today! I am using an SX1276 chip to communicate with the RC car over long distances. I made a transceiver that can be put in the car and in the remote control as well. Si

**3h**

I worked on the schematic for today! I am using an SX1276 chip to communicate with the RC car over long distances. I made a transceiver that can be put in the car and in the remote control as well. Since I have a HAM radio license, I will be able to communicate with the car over long distances!

I also calculated the width of the traces needed to make sure the car doesn't, like... explode! 50-ohm impedance, KiCad calculator -> boom! 0.36 mm traces required ayayay!

### 2026-10-07 – I did a LOT of changes since last work session! I changed the chip i'm using from an SX1276 to an LR1121! I also implemented a feature that lets me switch from 915 MHz to 2.4 GHz, which is pretty frea

**7.68h**

I did a LOT of changes since last work session! I changed the chip i'm using from an SX1276 to an LR1121! I also implemented a feature that lets me switch from 915 MHz to 2.4 GHz, which is pretty freaking awesome for me cuz I have an RC controller I can use! Anyways, the schematic is pretty much done, I have to implement a couple  of additional things so that the radio can, you know, interact with the car itself, but the main logic is completed.
